title: #RushTok: An Evaluation of Event-Based Communities on TikTok
venue: Association of Internet Researchers Annual Conference

summary.type: Editorial paraphrases with source locators; not quotations.

sources.version: Local doctoral colloquium research statement; cataloged for AoIR 2024

questions.text: How do event-based TikTok communities form, and how do creators and viewers understand participation?

methods.text: The statement describes ongoing qualitative content coding and proposes creator interviews and a viewer survey.

contributions.text: An early research agenda uses RushTok to study algorithmically assembled, event-based communities.

limitations.text: This statement proposes future studies and does not report the completed 2026 survey findings.

summary.coverageNote: Research proposal summary, not a report of completed empirical findings.
